content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/{id}` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`, backed by a new `getForRecipient` in `src/repos/messages.ts`. It looks the message up only where the signed-in user is the recipient, so any other user, role or practice gets a 404. Missing authentication gets a 401 from `requireUser`. For the recipient it marks the message read, writes an id-only audit entry, and returns exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from: {name}}`.

`npm run verify` passes (typecheck plus the 18 existing tests). I didn't add tests for the new endpoint.
